newsitem.title: USA: Reader's Digest sees FY97 EPS about $1.20.
newsitem.headline: Reader's Digest sees FY97 EPS about $1.20.

text.p: Reader's Digest Association Inc said Friday it expects to report earnings per share for the fiscal year ended June 30 of about $1.20, including fourth quarter charges in a range of $0.20 to $0.25 per share.
The company said the charges are associated with its strategic growth program, in which it will spend up to $400 million to boost its business..
The company said it expects there will be additional charges in fiscal 1998 in connection with this program.
Expected earnings per share also include charges of about $0.20 per share, primarily for inventory writedowns recorded in the fourth quarter.
The company said this is largely due to the unusually big difference between actual customer response to third and fourth quarter promotional mailings compared with expected response.

The company previously reported its fiscal 1997 results would be affected by lower customer response to many of its promotional mailings, increasing competitive pressures, and the continuing weakness of European economies. Actual results are scheduled to be reported in the middle of August.
